name: CartCure Ghost Recovery for WooCommerce
author: Ceaser mwangi

sections.description:
CartCure Ghost Recovery for WooCommerce helps you recover sales that would otherwise be lost forever.

Most cart-abandonment plugins only catch carts after a customer reaches checkout and gives up. This plugin starts earlier: it quietly tracks cart contents as visitors shop, so even a “ghost cart” — someone who never logged in, never entered an email, and just closed the tab — can often still be reconnected to their cart the next time they visit, or recovered by email if we captured their address at checkout.

Key Features (100% Free)

  • Ghost Cart Tracking — captures cart contents continuously, before a visitor ever reaches checkout
  • Abandoned Cart Detection — automatically flags carts that have gone cold, based on a threshold you control
  • One-Click Cart Restoration — recovery links rebuild the customer’s cart and send them straight to checkout
  • Automated Recovery Emails — a professionally designed “Complete Your Purchase” email, sent automatically
  • WooCommerce Store Scanner — checks for common revenue-killing issues like disabled guest checkout, missing SSL, and bloated checkout forms, each with a plain-English explanation and suggested fix
  • CartCure Dashboard — see recovered revenue, recovery rate, and your most-abandoned products at a glance
  • WooCommerce HPOS Compatible
  • Translation Ready
  • No artificial limits on cart recovery, ever

This plugin is, and will remain, completely free to use. If it helps your store, a donation is always appreciated but never required.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/cartcure-ghost-recovery, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Visit Revenue Recovery → Settings to configure abandonment thresholds and recovery email timing.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. CartCure Ghost Recovery is a WooCommerce extension and will not function without it.

Will this slow down my store?

Cart tracking runs on existing WooCommerce cart hooks and writes a single lightweight database row per change. Recovery email sending and abandonment detection run in the background via WP-Cron, not on customer-facing page loads.

Is there a paid version?

Not currently. All features described above are free with no limits.

Does this collect personal data?

The plugin stores cart contents and, when available, the customer’s email address, solely to enable cart recovery. This data is automatically deleted after the retention period configured in Settings (90 days by default). No data is sent to any third-party service.
